reason: E1 reports a 12-electron ethanol oxidation on IrOsPtPdRhRu but does not provide evidence for isolated Pt/Pd sites, d-band center shifts, or a ligand/strain mechanism. E2 shows charge transfer to Pt/Pd in a different HEA (PtPdCoCuNi) for a different reaction, offering only indirect, loosely related support for the electronic tuning premise. The key mechanistic premises thus lack direct, specific prior evidence.
premises: Random solid-solution arrangement creates isolated Pt and Pd active sites
Neighboring Rh, Ru, Ir, Os atoms modify Pt/Pd d-band centers via ligand and strain effects
This electronic tuning enhances adsorption of ethanol oxidation intermediates
Reducing non-noble neighbor content weakens tuning, shifting to partial oxidation
